planets.name: L 98-59 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of L 98-59 with a 7.45-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: L 98-59 d was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around L 98-59. Its orbit and size follow Cadieux et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.

quotes.title: L 98-59 d
quotes.card: L 98-59 d is an exoplanet orbiting the star L 98-59 34.6 light years from Earth.
quotes.introduction: L 98-59 d is the third, potentially fourth, planet in its system.
